system.description:
Will Amp

Once per casting, you gain a +1d10 bonus to damage you deal with Ninjutsu you cast.

You can use two or more Moldings at once as part of the same casting.

You can use the Draw Reserves skill Action, as an Action.

You do not benefit from the cost reduction any source. Casting a Jutsu at 0 Cost does not count as cost reduction.
system.summary: Once per casting +1d10 Ninjutsu damage, two or more Moldings, Draw Reserves as an Action, no cost reduction.

rules.text: Start: when you enter Crash or Flow, spend 1 Focus; your Bonded creature enters Flow Duality (give it that card). It loses 2 jutsu slots at the end of each of your turns.
The bonus damage is added automatically when you cast.
